gripOrHq.title: Emergency Rig
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

gripOrHq.title: Syd Meyer Superstores
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Trash a rezzed piece of ice. Gain [4].

gripOrHq.title: Security Purge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

gripOrHq.title: Executive Boot Camp
gripOrHq.rulesText: Discard a card at random: Gain [2]. Use this ability only during a run. At the end of the run, return to the bank any of the [2] you did not spend.

gripOrHq.title: Bug Zapper
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Dr. Dreff
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

rig.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

ice.title: Puzzle
ice.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.title: Puzzle
ice.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.title: Colonel Failure
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *End the run. *End the run.

ice.title: Coyote
ice.rulesText: *For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength, unless Runner pays [2] while passing Coyote. Gain [3] when you rez Coyote.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

setAside.title: Skivviss
setAside.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.
